en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.160 - Hanan ibn Sudair asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) saying:
'Sometimes I urinate and cannot find water, and it becomes difficult for me.'
Imam (as) said: 'If you urinate and dry yourself, then wipe your private part with your saliva. If you notice anything afterward, say, "This is from that."'.
